connect.title: Your power station, live in the browser.
connect.subtitle: See every watt flowing in and out, switch outputs, and know exactly how long your battery will last — no app install needed.
connect.demoHint: A realistic simulator. No hardware needed.
connect.showAll: Device not listed? Show all Bluetooth devices
connect.privacy: Runs entirely in your browser. Telemetry only goes to your own API, and only when it is running.

steps.title: How it works
steps.one: Turn the station on and keep it within a few metres.
steps.two: Pick the device named YIchu… in the browser's chooser.
steps.three: Live data starts streaming within a second.

live.title: Live energy flow
live.body: Watch watts move from the inputs into the battery and out to every port.

control.title: Full control
control.body: Toggle AC, DC and USB outputs, timers, charge limit and the display.

plan.title: Know your runtime
plan.body: Time left at the current load, per rail, plus a what-if planner.

unsupported.title: Bluetooth isn't available in this browser
unsupported.insecure: Web Bluetooth only works on https:// or on localhost. Open this page through a secure address.
unsupported.browsers: Use Chrome or Edge on Windows, macOS, Linux or ChromeOS, or Chrome on Android.
unsupported.ios: On iPhone and iPad, Safari has no Web Bluetooth. The Bluefy browser does.
unsupported.flag: On Linux you may need to enable chrome://flags/#enable-experimental-web-platform-features.
unsupported.demoInstead: You can still explore everything with the demo device.

error.title: Couldn't connect
error.help: Make sure the station is switched on and nearby, Bluetooth is enabled, and no phone is currently connected to it.

watch.title: Watch a station live
watch.body: Another browser is streaming these devices through your API.
watch.empty: No station is being streamed right now. Connect one in another tab and it appears here.

dashboard.title: Dashboard

empty.title: No station connected
empty.body: Connect your power station over Bluetooth, or start the demo to explore with simulated data.

dashboard.waiting: Waiting for the first frames from the station…
dashboard.watchOnly: Read-only — you are watching a station streamed by another browser.
dashboard.refreshed: Asked the station for its info again

socCritical.title: Battery critical
socCritical.body: Only {value} left. Reduce the load or connect a charger.

tempHigh.title: High temperature
tempHigh.body: The battery is at {value}. Give the station some air.

controls.title: Station controls
controls.description: Every change is sent to the station over Bluetooth and confirmed by its next status frame.
controls.chargeLimitHint: Caps the charging power. Lower is gentler on the battery.
controls.acConstantPowerHint: Keeps the inverter output steady for sensitive loads.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi setup
wifi.description: Send your network credentials to the station so it can reach the cloud.
wifi.warning: The station's protocol sends the password in plain text over Bluetooth. Only do this somewhere you trust.
wifi.done: Credentials sent. The station restarts its Wi-Fi.

details.title: Connection details
details.name: Name
details.gattHint: Like the original app, we use the first characteristic with read + write + notify. If the station stays silent, try another one.
details.demoGatt: The demo station has no GATT table: it plugs straight into the protocol layer.
details.watchGatt: You're watching a stream from another browser; there is no Bluetooth link here.
details.noServices: No services were accessible. Add your device's service UUID in Settings, then reconnect.

planner.title: Load planner
planner.subtitle: Figure out what you can run, and for how long.
planner.name: Name
planner.nothingSelected: Switch on a few appliances to see how long the battery lasts.
planner.exceeds: Peak load {value} exceeds the {rated} rated output — don't run everything at once.
planner.dutyHint: Share of time it actually draws power (a fridge compressor runs ~35% of the time).

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Downsampled telemetry stored by your API.

offline.title: API unreachable
offline.body: Start the API to see stored history. Showing this session's data meanwhile.

empty.title: No history yet
empty.body: Connect a station (or the demo) and data appears here within seconds. Tip: `pnpm --filter @myenergy/api seed:demo` fills 48 hours of sample data.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Saved in this browser and mirrored to the API when it is reachable.
settings.capacityHint: Nominal battery capacity. Leave on automatic to use the model preset.
settings.usableHint: Share of the nominal capacity the BMS lets you use.
settings.uuidHint: If your station doesn't connect, read its service UUID with nRF Connect on a phone and paste it here (fff0 or a full UUID). It is added to optionalServices.
settings.uuidInvalid: Use a 16-bit hex value (fff0) or a full 128-bit UUID.
settings.cloudSyncHint: Upload telemetry and stream live data to {url} when it is reachable.
settings.digitsHint: Show numbers as ۰۱۲۳ in the Persian interface.
settings.aboutBody: MyEnergy speaks the same Bluetooth protocol as the official MyEnergy Power app. Firmware updates (OTA) are intentionally not supported.
